title: Brooklyn Power Hour
description: A happy-hour stand-up show every Friday at 6pm at Eastville, hosted by Annette Mullaney, Dara Jemmott, Sara Shipley and Sarah Barnitt.
verification_note: Show page (RECURRING SHOW) states every Friday 6pm at 487 Atlantic Ave, from $20. Listed dates run through next June.

title: Comedians You Should Know
description: A weekly stand-up showcase at Greenpoint Comedy Club, hosted by Jeff Steinbrunner and Saurin Choksi. CYSK moved here in May 2026 after ten years at the Gutter Bar.
verification_note: GCC's calendar lists Comedians You Should Know every Wednesday at 8pm (Sep 16, Sep 23, etc.); show page states doors 7:30pm, 1-item minimum. CYSK's own site still shows the old Gutter Bar history.

title: We Have Fun
description: A free weekly stand-up show in the back room of a Park Slope bar, hosted by Zach Sims and Dan Wilbur. Lineups change weekly.
verification_note: Eventbrite listing states weekly on Wednesdays, doors 7:15pm, free. Brooklyn Paper listing corroborates through Dec 16.

title: Bitches' Brew
description: A five-year-running Friday stand-up show in the back room at Halyard's, produced by Naomi Karavani, Sabeen Sadiq, Blair Dawson and Andrea Allan.
verification_note: Organizer page states every Friday 8:30pm at Halyard's. Price not shown; confirm on the dated listing.

title: Faculty Lounge
price_label: Ticketed · $5 off before day of show
description: BCC's weekly stand-up night: a rotating lineup of favorites plus a wild-card spot for a past BCC stand-up alum. 21+, 35 seats then standing room.
verification_note: BCC's own show page says weekly on Sundays 8:30pm. Rechecked Sep 12 against the faculty-lounge-9-20 page (Eris Deep Space, doors 8:15pm, show 8:30pm, Sunday, 'stand up' show). BCC's overview page still lists it under Thursdays; the show page is authoritative.

title: Bomb Shelter Comedy
description: A no-cover, no-minimum bar show in Hell's Kitchen with TV-credit comics on most lineups. Twice a week.
verification_note: Eventbrite listing states Thursdays 8pm and Saturdays 9pm, free, no minimum. Specific upcoming dates not shown on the listing.

title: Kweendom
price_label: Free · donations to an LGBTQ org each week
description: A weekly LGBTQ stand-up showcase at Pete's Candy Store in Williamsburg, called 'consistently dope' by Time Out and 'extremely gay' by Thrillist. Always-fresh lineup of stand-up, storytelling, characters and music from up-and-coming artists and faces from TV and streaming.
source_label: Pete's calendar page (show description and weekly cadence)
verification_note: Pete's own calendar lists Kweendom on Fri Sep 18 with the show description calling out the weekly LGBTQ showcase and donation to a designated LGBTQ org. The Sep 19 Friday slot on the same week is the named showcase; other Fridays vary.

title: Hobocop
description: A weekly Tuesday stand-up showcase at The Grisly Pear (Greenwich Village), hosted by Candyce Cook and called by the venue 'the best new comedy show in town on the worst day of the week.'
verification_note: Grisly Pear's calendar lists 'HOBOCOP' with Candyce Cook as host; the venue's own Shows page describes it as 'the best new comedy show in town on the worst day of the week.' Multiple Tuesdays through Oct appear in the calendar.

title: Sunday Open Mic at Brooklyn Art Haus
description: A free Sunday open mic in the lounge at Brooklyn Art Haus in Williamsburg (sign-up at 5:30pm, 7pm end). The venue also runs the free Malev and Friends Comedy Show on a separate weekly slot — weekday not listed on the venue page; revisit when a show page confirms.
source_label: Brooklyn Art Haus Shows & Events page
verification_note: BAH homepage lists 'Open Mic every Sunday 5:30-7pm' alongside 'Malev and Friends Comedy Show — Come see free comedy in the lounge!'. Only the Sunday open mic has a published weekday and time; Malev and Friends is on a different weekly slot that the venue page does not name.
